scope: Contemporaneous national news and official documents bearing on when China was publicly described as Australia's leading trade partner, with metric and time-basis distinctions preserved.

sources.title: PM hails $25b China gas supply deal
sources.query_used: site:abc.net.au 2006 China Australia second largest trading partner
verification_markers: PM hails $25b China gas supply deal
China is now Australia's second largest trading partner
sources.excerpt_under_25_words: China is now Australia's second largest trading partner.
sources.interpretation: Contemporaneous national coverage supplies contrary rank evidence: China is second, not first.
sources.notes: The story concerns a gas agreement, but the rank statement is national and generic. It does not establish the precise trade denominator.

sources.title: The Changing Country Composition of Australia's Trade
sources.query_used: site:rba.gov.au 2006 China second-largest export destination Australia Japan
verification_markers: The Changing Country Composition of Australia's Trade
second-largest export destination in 2005
Japan remains Australia's largest export destination
sources.excerpt_under_25_words: China overtook the United States to become Australia's second-largest export destination in 2005.
sources.interpretation: Official contemporaneous evidence places China second among goods-and-services export destinations, behind Japan.
sources.notes: Useful for separating export rank from two-way trading-partner rank.

sources.title: China overtakes Japan in trade with Aust
sources.query_used: China overtakes Japan 2007 Australia biggest trading partner ABC
verification_markers: China overtakes Japan in trade with Aust

exports and imports between China and Australia
sources.excerpt_under_25_words: China has surpassed Japan as Australia's biggest trading partner.
sources.interpretation: Earliest directly verified national positive public cue recovered in this search.
sources.notes: Article gives combined imports and exports but does not clearly delimit goods versus goods and services. Posted 4 May and updated 9 May 2007.

sources.title: China unseats Japan as Australia's largest trade partner
sources.query_used: China unseats Japan Australia's largest trade partner 2007 ABC
verification_markers: China unseats Japan as Australia's largest trade partner
Mainland China has become Australia's biggest trading partner
combined value of imports and exports
sources.excerpt_under_25_words: Mainland China has become Australia's biggest trading partner, overtaking Japan.
sources.interpretation: Second directly verified national positive public cue in 2007, confirming persistence beyond the March rolling window.
sources.notes: The article identifies combined imports and exports; it does not resolve goods versus goods and services.

verification_markers: Australia's Composition of Trade 2008

trade in goods and services
sources.excerpt_under_25_words: Japan re-emerged as Australia's largest trading partner in 2008.
sources.interpretation: Calendar-year reversal: Japan displaced China in 2008, ruling out a three-calendar-year positive sequence beginning in 2006.
sources.notes: Preserved raw predates this focused collection and is reused by hash. China was second in two-way trade and first as an import source.
